subject: Hosted evaluation: endpoints, throttle windows & next steps
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@cartwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation: endpoints, throttle windows & next steps

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the demo this morning and for walking us through CartWave's summarization + search use case. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can provision a representative hosted sandbox for you: 

What we heard (summary)
- Primary need: high-quality summarization for customer conversations + embeddings for search and rerank.
- Traffic profile: spiky daytime traffic (marketing hours) with occasional large backfills.
- Data residency: you mentioned EU-only data at rest for production—important callout.

To provision a sandbox that mirrors production, can you confirm two quick numbers: 
1) Estimated peak RPS (requests/sec) at demo time traffic (not average)
2) Typical token count per request (input + expected output) — ballpark is fine

What we'll provision if hosted looks acceptable
- EU-hosted sandbox (separate tenant, data-at-rest in EU)
- Two endpoints: POST /v1/generate (sync) and POST /v1/stream (streaming for UI)
- Default throttle window we propose for the sandbox: per-endpoint concurrency 40, sustained RPS 25, burst RPS 200 for a 45s burst window. We can tune once we see real traffic.

Attachments: demo recording + a CSV we'll use to seed test keys for your sandbox.

Next steps / asks
- Reply with peak RPS and avg tokens (or a short sample of your traffic profile).
- If EU residency is a hard requirement for production, state that explicitly (helps us decide hosted EU vs Private).
- I'll send a DPA draft and a sandbox invite once we have the numbers.

Proposed timeline: reserve EU sandbox by EOD Tuesday if we get numbers today; otherwise aim for Thursday.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call to walk through the rate knobs.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0148

Attachments: demo-recording-20240421.mp4 (mp4), sandbox-invite-eu.csv (csv)

From: Samira Khan <samira@cartwave.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Platform Team <platform@cartwave.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2024 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: endpoints, throttle windows & next steps

Thanks Sofia — great walkthrough. Answers inline below.

> To provision a sandbox that mirrors production, can you confirm two quick numbers:

1) Peak RPS: around 75 RPS during major campaign spikes (sustained for ~10-20 minutes), with shorter microbursts up to ~220 RPS for <60s during promotions.
2) Typical tokens per request: input ~250 tokens, output ~100 tokens (so ~350 total).

EU residency: production data must remain in the EU. For evaluation, we can try an EU-hosted sandbox but we have to validate that logs and backups are EU-only.

Questions:
- What SLA/uptime do you guarantee for hosted EU tenants in production?
- Is there an easy path to move to Dedicated if we want reserved capacity later?

I've attached a short CSV with a small sample of request sizes.

If you can provision the sandbox in EU and share the handshake details (endpoints, credentials) we'll run a small load test next week and share telemetry.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Engineering, CartWave
samira@cartwave.com

Attachment: sample-traffic-profile.csv

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@cartwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2024 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: endpoints, throttle windows & next steps

Hi Samira —

Appreciate the quick details, very helpful. Notes and next steps below.

1) Traffic profile
- Peak/burst numbers you shared (75 sustained, microbursts to ~220) are well within what we can simulate in a hosted EU sandbox. We'll provision a sandbox with a burst ceiling that matches those microbursts.

2) EU residency
- Hosted EU option: we can spin up an EU-hosted tenant where data-at-rest and backups remain in-region. It's our standard for customers with EU residency requirements; SOC2 and encryption at rest apply. If CartWave requires on-prem or air-gapped deployment, that would be a Private deployment (different procurement).

3) SLA and path to Dedicated
- Hosted EU tenants: standard SLA is 99.9% with optional premium SLA for Dedicated.
- Migration path: you can start on hosted and upgrade to Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) when you want predictable throughput and isolation. We'll provide an export/migration plan and coordinate a canary cutover.

4) Sandbox configuration we'll provision now
- EU sandbox tenant (data at rest in EU)
- Endpoints: POST /v1/generate (sync) and POST /v1/stream (server-sent events)
- Token budget for trial: 500k tokens total across both endpoints
- Throttle window (sandbox): concurrency 50, sustained RPS 30, burst RPS 240 for 60s

5) Next operational steps
- I'll send a DocuSign for the DPA (attached draft). Please review and indicate any special clauses.
- Ben will provision the EU sandbox and share credentials + a short runbook for load testing.
- After you run the load test we'll capture metrics (latency P95, token efficiency) and iterate on throttle knobs.

Scheduling: I'll provision the sandbox today and Ben will share credentials by EOD. If you prefer a kickoff call for the load test, we can do Tuesday morning CEST.

Thanks — looking forward to the results.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

Attachments: DPA-draft-Redwood.pdf
